rules.statement: FEAT-007 and FEAT-010 must be selected by a parameter at elaboration and be present or absent, not run-time disabled.
The port list must be identical in every configuration except for port widths.
CFG-MIN (DEPTH 2, DATA_W 1, CFG-BASE features, FEAT-007 and FEAT-010 disabled) must be a legal instance and be verified by TEST-013.
CFG-BASE must have PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 0, PARA_SFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO = 0, DATA_W 32, DEPTH 8, and be verified by all tests.
CFG-RETIME must enable CFG-BASE plus FEAT-007 with PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1 and be verified by TEST-002, 006, 007, 009, 011, 015, 017.
CFG-MACRO must enable CFG-BASE plus FEAT-010 with PARA_SFIFO_MEM_USE_MACRO = 1 and be verified by TEST-002 and TEST-012.
CFG-ODD must support a DEPTH that is not a power of two, such as 5 or 12, verified by TEST-008.
Parameter combinations listed as illegal in Section 8 must not be used.
